baseline: Locked simplified v1 plus R180 K16 frozen joint readout; no production change.
diagnostic: Use exactly the 64+64+64 historical source calibration rows and the per-row original K16 native query IDs, signed PCA boxes and joint scores sealed by the native language displacement study. These 192 have historical development exposure. Predict and hash before opening their historical IoU arrays.
native_model: Each platform uses its own registered epoch100 in eval mode. Replay the ORIGINAL 3EED decoder, not the separate prepared v1 frontend pass. Preserve all 256 query identities, H0, memories, optional detector arguments, text and padding. Native dynamic replay must recover every original layer and last projected query. For the terminal schedules pass the full first pass last_center/last_pred_size, without yaw or clipping. No second-pass regression, backbone, tokenization, or text/point re-encoding.
probe: No fitting on the 192. Use the native frozen matching projection, temperature .07 and its existing text-derived noun span to calculate candidate log odds. As a parameter-free test of incremental ranking use the historical joint logit plus replay-minus-native noun log odds. Also report the two standalone native odds rankings. Ties in the historical frozen readout use its actual tie order. Run six-layer own terminal, fixed proposal geometry, frame-deranged terminal, and one-last-layer own terminal on the same inputs. Measure true geometric variation, hidden changes, crossings, best-good vs strongest-bad margins, hard pair AUC and synchronized timing. Post-encoder seed mean inside the final oriented PCA box is cached for the conditional learned pooling control; zero vectors denote empty support.
probe_decision: Before fitting any weight, measure strict good-vs-bad pair wins (ties half) for the incremental readout at 0.25 and 0.50; average per eligible (record, threshold), not per raw pair. Under the user's conditional last instruction, train the 288-coefficient heads when terminal replay improves this ranking vs frozen K16. Also report threshold changes and all controls even if this first gate fails. Gate concerns the existing frozen semantic readout and does not prove non-separability of a 288-D representation. The later source holdout gate, not the probe, decides target evaluation.
fit: If eligible, use all 640 natural fitting rows per source, same fixed K16, scores and geometry. Per platform and feature arm minimize a row/threshold-balanced positive-negative logistic loss plus lambda/2 times squared weight norm. Cold start is zero; no bias. Compare native last H; own terminal delta; initial delta; final PCA-box mean of post-cross-encoder point tokens; deranged terminal delta; last-layer-only delta. Include an additional recorded-geometry/text control (six final coordinates crossing 48 fixed grouped text features, 288 coefficients). A zero correction is always available. For each source use identical deterministic source-fit-only regularization selection on 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10 and zero-correction; use inner folds grouped by recording when possible, otherwise contiguous frame blocks within the single source fitting recording (disclose). Select lowest held-out balanced pair loss; tie favors zero then larger lambda. Outer 160 Waymo, 64 Drone and 160 Quad rows remain separated by recording from fit; disclose the 192 probe's overlap with outer holdout separately. No target configuration selection.
source_decision: If fitting occurs, report ordinary v1 and frozen K16, Acc@25, Acc@50, mean oriented IoU, rescues/harms, equal-platform and per-recording outcomes. Require actual net Acc@50 gains over frozen and higher Acc@50 than native last layer, fixed initial geometry, pooled memory and shuffled terminal. If a one-layer readout matches the six-layer readout, report simplification without calling it a six-layer effect. Inconclusive effects or lack of net rescues stop expansion; results of every attempted arm remain available.
ordinary: Only after passing the source condition, lock the selected source weights and evaluate all 18,620 previously used ordinary direction records with the original fixed candidate geometry and the same controls. Seal before scoring, pair per recording and report small recording counts. No FINAL.
